description.description: A close-up portrait of Donald Trump looking directly at the camera with a stern, furrowed expression. He is wearing a dark blue suit jacket, a white collared shirt, and a solid blue tie. An American flag lapel pin is visible on his left lapel. In the background, there is a blurred American flag on the left and dark, ornate wooden paneling on the right.

A wide interior shot of the French National Assembly (Palais Bourbon) during a session. Members are seated in a grand hemi-cycle with red velvet benches facing the speaker’s rostrum and a large tapestry. The walls are decorated with classical statues, gold ornamentation, and dark green panels. Several digital screens display timers and legislative information. Figures at the center are seated behind ornate marble and wood desks.
